calibration_sources: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents (CodeAct Paper, ICML: Programmatic Control Flow vs JSON ReAct)
Model Context Protocol (MCP) Deferred Tool Loading (tool_search_tool) & Dynamic Schema Expansion Benchmarks
vLLM / SGLang Agentic Prefix-Cache Pinning Across External Tool I/O Waits

workload.enterprise_mcp_catalog: 25 Enterprise MCP Servers (500 Total Tools = 65,000 Tokens of Raw JSON Schema)
workload.workflow_profile: Multi-System Triage Workflow Requiring 12 Dependent/Parallel Tool Calls (e.g. Fetch Alerts -> Query Logs -> Inspect PRs -> Update Ticket)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 全量 500 工具 Schema 硬塞 (65K 词) + 串行 ReAct 乒乓 + 原始 JSON 回灌
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Full 500-Tool Schema Stuffing (65K Tok) + Serial ReAct + Raw JSON Dump
tiers.tool_discovery_mode: Injects all 500 MCP tool JSON schemas into system prompt on every turn (65,000 tokens base)
tiers.execution_and_payload_mode: Serial 1-by-1 ReAct loop (13 LLM turns) + dumps unfiltered 18KB REST JSON responses into context
tiers.recommended_for: Toy agents with <=5 tools and tiny responses; catastrophic at enterprise scale (500 schemas confuse tool selection and 13 serial turns burn 210K tokens/task).

tiers.name: Tier 2: 静态向量 Top-15 工具预检索 + 并行 JSON Function Calling (仍回灌原始大包)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Static Vector Top-15 Tool Retrieval + Parallel JSON Tool Calls
tiers.tool_discovery_mode: Pre-filters Top-15 tools via initial user prompt embedding (misses mid-task cross-domain tools)
tiers.execution_and_payload_mode: Parallel JSON tool calls (5 LLM turns), but still returns full unfiltered API JSON arrays to LLM
tiers.recommended_for: Simple single-step parallel lookups where the initial prompt explicitly names all required tools.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 按需延迟工具发现 (Deferred Tool Search) + 会话粘性 KV 驻留异步网关
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Deferred Tool Discovery (tool_search) + Session-Sticky KV-Pinned Gateway
tiers.tool_discovery_mode: Exposes 800-token catalog index + dynamic tool_search expansion (loads only exact 4–6 needed schemas)
tiers.execution_and_payload_mode: Parallel JSON calls + Sticky KV-Pinned Routing (holds KV Cache in VRAM/DRAM during 420ms API wait)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard interactive MCP agents requiring explicit per-call human-in-the-loop confirmation.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 延迟发现 + 程序化工具编排 (CodeAct 沙箱循环) + 响应字段投影裁剪
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Deferred Discovery + Programmatic Tool Calling (CodeAct Sandbox) + Output Projection
tiers.tool_discovery_mode: Deferred tool_search loads typed SDK stubs on demand (98.5% schema token reduction)
tiers.execution_and_payload_mode: LLM emits 1 Python/TS script executing all 12 MCP calls, loops, & JMESPath filtering inside Wasm/MicroVM sandbox (2 LLM turns total!)
tiers.recommended_for: Production enterprise SRE, data analysis, and DevOps agents executing multi-step loops, pagination, and cross-system joins (10.1x faster, -95.6% cost).
